"Like a lion, king of the beasts, that gnaws and chews and worries its prey, Not fazed in the least by a bunch of shepherds who arrive to chase it off, So God-of-the-Angel-Armies comes down to fight on Mount Zion, to make war from its heights.
God-of-the-Angel-Armies protects Jerusalem. I'll protect and rescue it. Yes, I'll hover and deliver."
Repent, return, dear Israel, to the One you so cruelly abandoned.
On the day you return, you'll throw away—every last one of you—the no-gods your sinful hands made from metal and wood.
